name: Wagner College High School Internship Program
org: Wagner College, Department for Lifelong Learning
what_you_do: Work as a teacher's helper in college youth classes. Classes include musical theater, acting, dance, fine arts, computers and Lego robotics. You help with projects and set up materials. You keep kids safe at drop-off and pick-up.
who_can_apply: High school sophomores, juniors and seniors. No age rule is stated.
pay_detail: No pay or fee is mentioned. You get community service hours and a certificate of completion from Wagner College.
duration: The fall session runs Oct 2 to Dec 12 (year not stated), on Fridays 5:30 to 8 p.m. or Saturdays 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. (hours depend on class).
deadline_text: No application deadline is listed. The page gives the fall session as Oct 2 to Dec 12 (year not stated). Spring dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Send the application form, a one-page essay (500 words max) about your goals, and a parent or guardian signature. You can apply online, by mail or by email. Contact: lifelong-learning@wagner.edu, 718-390-3221.
notes: Ask the office whether spring 2027 spots are open and whether the internship is paid.
